summary: Austin, Texas, self-taught programmer, CEO of own company for 14 years, former Microsoft employee, strong interest in Python and web development frameworks (especially web2py), experienced in embedded systems and compiler implementation, has two handicapped children requiring long-term care, strong anti-illegal immigration stance, values legal immigration, advocates for self-education and continuous skill development, enjoys reading and writing about technology and programming, has a background in technical writing, interested in DIY projects and home improvement, has a family structure that includes a spouse who is an immigrant.
